instruction: Search "kubernetes/kubernetes" for the latest open issue with keyword "documentation". Write it as "#<number> <title>" to "$HOME/Desktop/gh_issue_search_4_2.txt". Save an empty file if no match exists.
reference_command: gh issue list --repo kubernetes/kubernetes --state open --search 'documentation sort:created-desc' --limit 1 --json number,title --jq '.[] | "#\(.number) \(.title)"' > "$HOME/Desktop/gh_issue_search_4_2.txt"
